source: AzurePublicDataset official GHCP Coding Agent June2026 release
model_policy: all six v2 Coding/LMM peak HGB models fixed; no retraining or source selection using evaluation
target: 5minute prompt-token totals from chosen session partitions; peak from current bin through ready bin
aggregation: all recorded nonnegative integer prompt counts at recorded LLM-call timestamps, including cancelled/failed outcomes if prompt is known; no tool/completion/cached features
feature_schema: v2 eleven past token features, with actual UTC clock/weekend
feedback: v2 same positive normalized residual q90 rule, only fully matured previous origins, first_origin12, window288, minimum96, both model and baseline
baseline_selection: minimum raw peak pinball on June5 complete targets only; same baseline for two source models at each horizon
quality_gate: exact repeated canonical call records zero; invalid prompt records<=1% of all LLM calls; at least274 of288 supported bins/day before forecast scoring
gate: mean pinball reduction>=5%; both days lower pinball; each day model coverage85..95%
incomplete_targets: final delay bins excluded from forecast evaluation
assumptions: prompt count available at call origin
feedback delivered immediately after bin close
scope_limits: chosen partition session sample rather than full population
other-date session calls may be missing
cached prompts counted in input demand
six reported comparisons, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim
no app requirement or actual VM/SLO/action labels
schema_fix: Message IDs are observed turn/group identifiers, reused by different timestamped calls. Count all recorded call occurrences like official trace_loader; do not collapse by message_id. Audit exact canonical payload repeats separately, with zero gate. Date/method/feedback/metrics/performance gates unchanged.
prior_exposure: Original ID-based audit and five sample session structures inspected. No model forecast or evaluation score has been computed.
